title: Mo Taps
learning_objectives: Notice a repeating pattern and predict the next page
Explain the surprise on the last page
parent_prompts: Before reading: Mo likes to tap things. What sound does a pot make when you tap it?
After page 3: What do you think Mo will tap next?
After reading: Why did the cat run? Was the cat a good thing to tap?

pages.illustration_brief: Mo (yellow round bird) beside a grey pot, beak touching it; small sound lines, no letters.

vocabulary.definition: Hits something very gently, once or twice.
vocabulary.example: She taps the door with one finger.

pages.image_alt: Mo beside a grey pot; sound lines.

pages.illustration_brief: Mo beside a small white cup on a table; sound lines.
pages.image_alt: Mo beside a small white cup on a table.

pages.illustration_brief: Mo on top of a red drum; bigger sound lines.
pages.image_alt: Mo on top of a red drum; big sound lines.

pages.illustration_brief: Mo beside a brown cardboard box.
pages.image_alt: Mo beside a brown cardboard box.

pages.illustration_brief: Mo beside a sleeping grey cat, beak just touching its back; the cat's eye is opening.
pages.image_alt: Mo beside a sleeping grey cat, beak just touching its back.

pages.text: Meow! The cat runs. Mo runs too!
pages.illustration_brief: The cat dashes off to the right with fur up; Mo flaps after it, both moving.
pages.audio_script: Meow! The cat runs. Mo runs too!
pages.image_alt: The cat dashes right with tail up; Mo flaps after it.

quiz.prompt: What sound does the drum make?
quiz.explanation: Page 3 says: Mo taps the drum. Boom!
Page 5: Mo taps the cat. Page 6: Meow! The cat runs. The tap made the cat run.

quiz.prompt: Which thing was not a good thing to tap?
quiz.explanation: The pot, cup, drum and box just made sounds. The cat woke up and ran away.

quiz.prompt: Tell a grown-up all the things Mo tapped, in order. What happened at the end?
quiz.rubric: not yet: names one object; with support: three objects with prompting; independent: four objects in order and says the cat ran
quiz.explanation: Recalling the list in order and the ending shows the child followed the pattern and the twist.

activities.prompt: Match the thing to its sound.

prompts: What would you tap to make a loud sound? A soft sound?
How do you think the cat felt?

off_screen_prompt: Tap three things at home very gently. Tell someone which one was loudest.
